scenario: [LNUL.4.10] / [LERR.1.4.11]: the twin of LNUL.4.10.trap_beside_a_type_error_yields_the_type_error. Each `==` has two faulting operands -- `p.a // p.z > 0` traps and `p.body.name > 5` raises a TypeError -- and yields the TypeError, so the DIVIDE_BY_ZERO is not the expression's fault and is NOT recorded, on either side. In `trap_left` the trap is met first in a left-to-right evaluation, which is what makes this pin the selection rather than the order. Path: the non-connective BINOP arm -- libds rete/eval.c BINOP (faults held, one raised), Mercury ds.eval.m eval_node(e_binop(...)) (lnul_4_10_yielded).
rules_ds:
schema Payload scope logical:
    body: Json key
    a: Int mutable
    z: Int mutable

rule trap_left:
    Payload p where (p.a // p.z > 0) == (p.body.name > 5)
->
    log info "left"

rule trap_right:
    Payload p where (p.body.name > 5) == (p.a // p.z > 0)
->
    log info "right"
